# YouTube
- **feat(YouTube - Whitelist)**: Add `Whitelist SponsorBlock` and `Whitelist Speed`
- **feat(YouTube - Custom Filter)**: Custom filtering of the protocol buffer
Some example: https://t.me/ReXgroups/58
- **feat(YouTube - Version)**: Add support for `v19.03.xx` and `v19.04.xx`
- **feat(YouTube - Patch)**: Add `Disable rolling number animations`
- **feat(YouTube - Spoof App Version)**: Add version `16.08.35` - Restore Old explorer tab
- **feat(YouTube - Spoof App Version)**: Add version `18.09.39` - Restore Old library Tab
- **fix(YouTube - Hide Suggested Video Overlay)**: Autoplay not worked when turning on
- **fix(YouTube - Return YouTube Dislike)**: Correct Seperator Color when Spoofing to older version
- **refactor(YouTube - Heading)**: Change from `PremiumHeadingPatch` to `CustomBrandingHeadingPatch`
https://www.reddit.com/r/revancedextended/comments/17tkxmu/suggestion_custom_brand_heading/
- Translation update

# YouTube Music
- **feat(YouTube Music - Patch)**: Add `Hide For You shelf` patch
- **refactor(YouTube Music)**: Remove version restriction

# Reddit
- **refactor(Reddit)**: Remove version restriction
